messages:
violet: Quick sync  saw reproducible quality drift for long-context LLMs when FP8/INT8/4bit slices share eviction lanes. This one looks like mixing quant footprints -> eviction thrash -> late-token degradation. Short thread to pick a minimally invasive rollout.
rajiv: Do we have a tight metric correlation? how much deg and over what cohort?
violet: Degscore up ~0.09 -> 0.18 on a longctx regression set for mixed-pack windows. Affected tenants are long-document summarizers. Logs show bursty page compactions + kv_miss spikes.
tom: Two parallel remedies: (1) a compatibility/ABI layer for quant profiles so cached blobs carry a micro-header and safe-guarded deserializers, (2) a policy layer that enforces per-tenant "quality budgets" that can request strict fidelity (no cross-quant packing) for N minutes.
anya: ABI layer is low-risk and gives us deterministic detection of format mismatch. Quality-budget idea maps well to product: opt-in SLA that pins tenant to mono-bit buckets for longctx heavy workloads.
rajiv: But strict pinning hurts throughput. Need hybrid: grace-period hysteresis + sampling to decide when to escalate. Proposal: if tenant rolling deg > 0.06 over 5m, switch to fidelity-pin for 30m. Expose this as a runtime flag per-tenant.
violet: Also need richer telemetry. Suggest fields: "quant_header_present", "page_compact_count", "kv_miss_rate", "tenant_quality_budget", "bits_seq", "deg_delta" and a small "replay_fp" (sha1) that identifies the prompt+seed. Keep events light.
tom: For ABI header, keep it tiny: 1 byte magic, 1 byte ver, 1 byte quant_id, 2 bytes len (5 bytes total). On read, if magic mismatch -> skip and log. Also support an opt-in compatibility mode that pads older entries.
anya: For rollout: (A) deploy ABI header in staging and run 20% shadow writes (no read enforcement), (B) enable read-enforcement + sampling on 5% canary, (C) if stable, enable tenant-quality-budget hooks and offer opt-in.
rajiv: Replayability: capture compact tuple for each sampled request: (model_sha, prompt_fp, seed, initial_kv_digest, bits_seq, tenant_id). We'll store replay_fp in traces so SRE can retarget replays. Recommend 0.5% sampling.
violet: Scheduling policy note: a windowed affinity scheduler that prefers same-bit lanes for pinned tenants but otherwise packs opportunistically. Implement as an extension to the existing packing scheduler with a small bounded tenant-state cache (LRU).
tom: Implementation details: scheduler will consult tenant-state with O(1) lookups; if pinned -> only allow packs where bits_seq is homogeneous or batch size=1; else normal heuristics. Need to microbench expected loss in tokens/sec for top N tenants.
anya: Ops: can we run a canary plan? ops-bot: Canary created: abi-header-shadow-20pct starting 6560001300; canary report to #eng-ml-canaries.
rajiv: Action items: violet -> open RFC issue summarizing telemetry + replay tuple; tom -> prototype ABI header encode/decode and microbench; anya -> design tenant-quality-budget API and UI flag; ops -> run shadow and then read-enforcement canary.
violet: I'll draft the RFC with concrete telemetry schema and a couple of sample graphs. Ping me on PR review. :thumbsup:
